title: First special sitting of 2024
summary: This was a short special sitting held outside the normal term, the first of 2024. The Speaker announced it was called at members' request to deal with two matters. A moment of silence was held for the late Abdul Aziz Abdulla, a former member of the Majlis. The nomination of Abbas Shareef for Prosecutor General was sent to the Judiciary Committee, and the Companies Act amendment bill had its first reading before the sitting closed.
